# AI Development & Deployment Lifecycle — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Gate review

*Module 1: Phases 1-4 · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_gate_review_phases_1_4.py`): Fill data/project.yaml for a project you know. Run the review. Present the gate decision to the room as the sponsor would hear it: go, conditional go, or stop.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Mock project through all gates

*Module 2: Phases 5-8 · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_mock_project_all_gates.py`): Take your project through all eight phases. Which phase has the least evidence? That is where your go-live risk lives.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
